name: 54246 · Washington Is, WI
findings: ZIP 54246 (Washington Is) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (62%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 54246 (Washington Is) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 54246 (Washington Is) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 5.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
